title: Media Aliquoting
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Load tube racks
steps.instruction: Place the 24‑tube tube racks sequentially in deck slots 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9.

steps.title: Load tip racks
steps.instruction: Place one Opentrons 96‑tip rack (1000 µL) for every two tube racks in deck slots 1 and 4.

steps.title: Load reagent reservoirs
steps.instruction: Place one NEST 1‑well reservoir (195 mL) for every three tube racks in deck slots 11 (first used) and 10.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, enter the number of plates to process (choose 1‑6), the desired transfer volume in µL, and select the mount side for the P1000 GEN2 single‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Verify deck layout
steps.instruction: Ensure the deck is arranged exactly as described: tube racks in slots 2,3,5,6,7,8,9; tip racks in slots 1,4; reservoirs in slots 11 and 10.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, perform calibration of all loaded labware, tip racks, and the P1000 GEN2 pipette according to the provided calibration tips.
